primary_title: Molecular insights into the activation of a G protein-coupled receptor by a neuropeptide
decision_basis: Neurotensin NTS(8-13) is resolved in an agonist-bound rat NTSR1 structure, defining direct peptide recognition and an active-like receptor architecture
limitations_preserved: Promote direct NTS(8-13)-NTSR1 binding and activation-compatible architecture; preserve peptide-fragment specificity and no G-protein or SCI inference.

primary_title: Molecular cloning and expression of a substance P receptor
decision_basis: Substance P binds the cloned human NK1 receptor and stimulates phosphatidylinositol metabolism in receptor-expressing cells
limitations_preserved: Promote substance P binding/activation of TACR1/NK1R; preserve recombinant COS-cell context and tachykinin ligand overlap, without CNS/glial or SCI inference.

primary_title: Structural basis for the activation of a G protein-coupled receptor by a peptide hormone
decision_basis: Arginine vasopressin is resolved in an active human V2R-Gs cryo-EM complex, defining direct agonist recognition and Gs-coupled activation architecture
limitations_preserved: Promote AVP binding/activation of AVPR2/V2R; preserve V2R/Gs renal-receptor context and no terminal-TF or SCI inference.

primary_title: Cloning and functional expression of the human motilin receptor
decision_basis: Motilin activates human and rabbit MLNR/GPR38 in recombinant cells with peptide binding, calcium mobilization and G-protein activation, with gastric contraction support
limitations_preserved: Promote motilin binding/activation of MLNR/GPR38; preserve human/rabbit species scope and the limited rodent motilin system, without SCI inference.

primary_title: Structural basis of cholecystokinin receptor activation by a potent agonist
decision_basis: Sulfated CCK-8 and CCK-58 bind and activate CCK1R in receptor-expressing cells, with calcium signaling, internalization and receptor-oligomerization readouts
limitations_preserved: Promote sulfated CCK peptide binding/activation of CCK1R; preserve CCK-8/CCK-58 form and do not collapse into generic CCK or infer SCI function.

primary_title: The cytoplasmic domain of integrin beta 1A is a ligand for talin
decision_basis: Talin binds recombinant beta1A cytoplasmic-tail mimics and the Y788A mutation disrupts the direct interaction in biochemical assays
limitations_preserved: Promote direct beta1A-tail/talin-1 association; preserve beta1A versus beta1D numbering and tail-mimic limits, without universal beta1-heterodimer or SCI inference.

primary_title: Syndecan-1 interacts with syntenin through its cytoplasmic domain
decision_basis: The syndecan-1 C-terminal EFYA motif binds syntenin-1 in yeast-two-hybrid, SPR, ligand-overlay and epithelial-cell co-immunoprecipitation assays
limitations_preserved: Promote direct SDC1 EFYA/syntenin-1 PDZ binding; preserve cytoplasmic-tail and syndecan-family context, without generalized growth-factor or SCI inference.

primary_title: The cytoplasmic tail of sortilin contains a sorting determinant for interaction with GGA proteins
decision_basis: Sortilin cytoplasmic-tail DXXLL motifs bind GGA2 VHS-domain activity and regulate intracellular trafficking in chimeric-receptor assays
limitations_preserved: Promote direct sortilin-tail/GGA2 sorting association; preserve DXXLL motif and GGA2-specific chimeric-trafficking context, without generalizing to all GGA proteins or SCI inference.

primary_title: The LRP1 cytoplasmic domain binds the FE65 adaptor protein
decision_basis: The distal LRP1 NPVY4507 motif binds FE65 PTB-domain constructs in phosphorylation-sensitive pulldown, SPR and biochemical interaction assays
limitations_preserved: Promote direct phosphorylation-sensitive LRP1 distal-tail/FE65 docking; preserve human motif/domain scope and do not generalize to all LRP1 trafficking or SCI function.
